persos.pose: sitting at the small table in the foreground on the left, cup in hand

persos.desc: wife in her late 30s, olive-and-copper pagne dress, headscarf, empty hands
persos.pose: standing on the right, hands on her hips

persos.desc: young woman housemaid in her 20s, plum-and-aubergine work dress, hair tied back, holding ONE single small suitcase
persos.pose: standing by the counter in the middle, suitcase in hand, calm

dialogue: Chérie, la bonne-là dit qu'elle démissionne dêh !
Pourquoi ? Elle est comme membre de la famille dêh !
Justement, Madame. Regardez Patron dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The husband announces it, worried, holding his cup without drinking, his face turned three-quarters to the camera. The wife answers, outraged, one hand on her chest, her face clearly visible. The housemaid, suitcase in hand, tilts her head toward the husband and says her line politely, her face clearly visible.
chute: The wife slowly turns her head toward the husband. The husband looks down at himself, crushed. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the worried husband's crushed face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: PATRON QUI RÉFLÉCHIT À DÉMISSIONNER AUSSI :
mecanisme: argument de l'épouse retourné + relance assassine de la bonne (le mari comme contre-exemple)

persos.desc: the wife's mother in her 60s, rose-and-ivory kaftan, big glasses, holding ONE single handbag on her knees
persos.pose: sitting on the sofa on the right, handbag on her knees, frowning

persos.desc: wife in her 30s, very slim, fuchsia-and-cherry house dress, hair in a bun, empty hands
persos.pose: standing in the middle, hands clasped

persos.desc: husband in his 40s, very round belly, lilac-and-jade boubou, holding ONE single empty plate
persos.pose: sitting in the armchair in the foreground on the left, plate resting on his belly, satisfied

dialogue: Ma fille, pourquoi ton mari-là grossit et toi tu maigris ?
Maman, il dit c'est l'amour qui nous nourrit dêh.
Ya fohi. Et moi, j'aime beaucoup.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The mother-in-law asks, frowning at the husband, her face turned three-quarters to the camera. The wife answers sweetly and naively, her face clearly visible. The husband pats his belly with his free hand and says his line with a satisfied smile, his face clearly visible.
chute: The mother-in-law clutches her handbag in shock. The wife slowly looks at the husband's belly. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the big husband's smug face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: BELLE-MAMAN QUI REPART AVEC SA FILLE :
mecanisme: formule romantique prise au pied de la lettre + aveu satisfait du coupable
